class.name: VMLResourceRouter
class.brief_description: Native ResourceFormatLoader resolving `vml://namespace:path` to the winning provider.
class.description: Registered automatically at engine start. Makes `load("vml://ns:path")` work, including in exported builds (native loaders are registered at the C++ level). Data ids (.json/.csv) are not Resources; read them with VML.get_data() instead.
